name: Isometric Hypercube Embedding
statement: A connected graph $G$ belongs to the class when there are an integer $n$ and an injective map $\varphi\colon V(G)\to\{0,1\}^n$ such that $d_G(u,v)=d_{Q_n}(\varphi(u),\varphi(v))$ for every pair of vertices $u,v$.
hypotheses: Connected graph; the frozen survey formulation uses a finite-dimensional hypercube $Q_n$.
comments: This is the primary catalogue definition. The least possible n is the isometric dimension of G.
